topic: Booking a First Annual Physical with a Family Doctor

script.title: THE FIRST CHECKUP
script.scene_zh: 診所電話 · 預約健檢
script.story_hook: A brand-new student calls the clinic.
script.intro_zh: 剛來報到的學生，撥出了給診所的那通電話。
script.welcome_en: Hi, today's scene is a phone call. Listen for clinic booking phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，今天的場景是一通電話。留意預約診所的實用說法。
script.outro: And that's a checkup on the calendar. Listen again and repeat along.
script.outro_zh: 一次健檢就這樣排進了行事曆。再聽一遍，大聲跟著說說看。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a college-age young man in his early twenties with sandy blonde hair in a messy low ponytail, a faded university hoodie, big over-ear headphones around his neck, freckles, and a lanky build
script.char_b_description: a middle-aged woman in her fifties with shoulder-length silver-grey hair, rectangular reading glasses, a lavender cardigan over a white blouse, a small wristwatch, and an average build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm calling to book a checkup, I think?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪm ˈkɔlɪŋ tə bʊk ə ˈtʃɛkˌʌp aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我想打電話預約一個年度健檢，應該沒打錯吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You reached the right desk! Is this your first visit?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɹitʃt ðə ɹaɪt dɛsk ɪz ðɪs jɔɹ fɝst ˈvɪzɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你找對地方了！這是你就診的第一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First time, yes. I just moved here for school.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɝst taɪm jɛs aɪ dʒʌst muːd hɪɹ fɚ skul/
dialogue.zh: 第一次，沒錯。我為了上學剛搬來這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome to town! Do you have a name for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛlkəm tə taʊn du ju hæv ə neɪm fɚ mi/
dialogue.zh: 歡迎來這邊。方便告訴我你的名字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's Daniel Reyes. First name Daniel, last Reyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈdænjəl ˈɹeɪəz fɝst neɪm ˈdænjəl læst ˈɹeɪəz/
dialogue.zh: 我叫 Daniel Reyes。前面是名字，最後是姓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, Daniel. Are you, um, a new patient here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt ˈdænjəl ɑɹ ju ʌm ə nu ˈpeɪʃənt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，Daniel。你是要登記成新病患嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I think so? What does that involve, exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk soʊ wət dʌz ðət ɪnˈvaɪl ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 應該是吧？具體要做些什麼呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just some forms: history, contact, insurance.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst sʌm fɔɹmz hɪˈstɔɹi ˈkɑntækt ɪnˈʃʊɹəns/
dialogue.zh: 就幾張表格：病史、聯絡資訊、保險。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I fill those online, or is paper faster?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ fɪl ðoz ˈɑnˌlaɪn ɔɹ ɪz ˈpeɪpɚ ˈfæstɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那些可以在線上填嗎？還是紙本比較快？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Online saves you twenty minutes in the waiting room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnˌlaɪn seɪvz ju ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnəts ɪn ðə ˈwɛitɪŋ rum/
dialogue.zh: 線上填的話，你在候診間能省二十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sold. Well, I mean, my laptop is always with me.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊld wɛl aɪ min maɪ ˈlæptɑp ɪz ˈɔlˌweɪz wɪð mi/
dialogue.zh: 好，就這樣說定。我是說，我筆電隨時帶在身邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, perfect. Now, do you have insurance?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈpɝfɪkt naʊ du ju hæv ɪnˈʃʊɹəns/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，太好了。請問你有保險嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I do, through the university. Should I have it handy?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ du θɹu ðə ˌjunəˈvɝsəti ʃʊd aɪ hæv ɪt ˈhændi/
dialogue.zh: 有的，學校的保險。通話時我要把卡拿在手邊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes please, I need the member ID while we talk.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliz aɪ nid ðə ˈmɛmbɚ aɪˈdi waɪl wi tɔk/
dialogue.zh: 要的，我這邊就需要你的會員編號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me grab my card... okay, ready now.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi ɡɹæb maɪ kɑɹd oʊˈkeɪ ˈɹædi naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我拿一下卡……好了，準備妥當。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, you can read it out to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ju kən rid ɪt aʊt tə mi/
dialogue.zh: 很好，你直接念給我聽就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says U-H three, then eight digits.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɛz ju eɪtʃ θɹi ðɛn eɪt ˈdɪdʒəts/
dialogue.zh: 上面寫 U-H 三，接著是八位數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. And your date of birth, please?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt ænd jɔɹ deɪt əv bɝθ pliz/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。請再告訴我你的出生日期？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: March ninth, two thousand and three.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɑɹθ naɪnθ tu ˈθaʊzənd ænd θɹi/
dialogue.zh: 三月九日，兩千零三年。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you. So, do you have any health concerns?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju soʊ du ju hæv ˈɛni hɛlθ kənˈsɝnz/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。那麼，你目前身體有什麼狀況嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, honestly, none. I just want the basic checkup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ˈɑnəstli nʌn aɪ dʒʌst wɑnt ðə ˈbeɪsɪk ˈtʃɛkˌʌp/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，老實說沒有，我只想做基本的健檢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the smartest reason to book one, truly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə smɑɾəst ˈɹizən tə bʊk wʌn ˈtɹuli/
dialogue.zh: 說真的，這正是最聰明的就醫理由。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hear annual physicals take a whole morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hɪɹ ˈænjuəl ˈfɪzɪkəlz teɪk ə hoʊl ˈmɔɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我聽說年度健檢要花掉一整個上午。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About forty minutes, plus quick lab work after.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt ˈfɔɾti ˈmɪnəts plʌs kwɪk læb wɝk ˈæftɚ/
dialogue.zh: 大約四十分鐘，結束後還有快速的抽血檢查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lab work... blood draw, you mean?
dialogue.phonetic: /læb wɝk blʌd dɹɔ ju min/
dialogue.zh: 抽血檢查……是說要打針抽血那種嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, cholesterol and sugar, the standard panel.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs kəˈlɛstɚoʊl ænd ˈʃʊɡɚ ðə ˈstændɚd ˈpænəl/
dialogue.zh: 對，膽固醇和血糖，就是標準的檢查組合。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, do I need to fast for that?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ du aɪ nid tə fæst fɚ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，做這個檢查需要空腹嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, nothing but water for eight hours.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp ˈnʌθɪŋ bət ˈwɔɾɚ fɚ eɪt ˈaʊɚz/
dialogue.zh: 要的，八小時內只能喝水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, fasting means no coffee at all?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ˈfæstɪŋ minz noʊ ˈkɑfi ət ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 等等，空腹連一點咖啡都不能喝嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, not even a tiny sip, doctor's rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑɹi nɑt ˈivən ə ˈtaɪni sɪp ˈdɑktɚz ɹul/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，連小小一口都不行，醫生的規定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's my favorite ritual, but fine, no coffee.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts maɪ ˈfeɪvɹət ˈɹɪtʃuəl bət faɪn noʊ ˈkɑfi/
dialogue.zh: 那可是我最愛的晨間儀式，但好吧，不喝就不喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll get you through it. Now, morning or afternoon?
dialogue.phonetic: /wil ɡɛt ju θɹu ɪt naʊ ˈmɔɹnɪŋ ɔɹ ˌæfɚˈnun/
dialogue.zh: 撐得過去的。好，想約上午還是下午？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mornings are tricky, my first class runs till noon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɔɹnɪŋz ɑɹ ˈtɹɪki maɪ fɝst klæs ɹʌnz tɪl nun/
dialogue.zh: 上午不太方便，我第一節課要上到中午。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then afternoons it is. Any day you prefer?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˌæfɚˈnunz ɪt ɪz ˈɛni deɪ ju prəˈfɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 那就都看下午。有沒有特別想選的日子？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thursdays work best, um, I work early Fridays.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɝzˌdeɪz wɝk bɛst ʌm aɪ wɝk ˈɝli ˈfɹaɪˌzdeɪz/
dialogue.zh: 星期四最方便，嗯，我星期五要上早班。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thursday the twentieth, afternoon opening at two-fifteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɝzˌdeɪ ðə ˈtwɛntiɪθ ˌæfɚˈnun ˈoʊpənɪŋ æt tu ˈfaɪftn/
dialogue.zh: 二十號星期四，下午兩點十五有空檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two-fifteen sounds perfect, I'll take that slot.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈfaɪftn ˈsaʊndz ˈpɝfɪkt aɪl teɪk ðæt slɑt/
dialogue.zh: 兩點十五很棒，這個時段我要了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One second, checking the calendar... oh, hold on.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈsɛkənd ˈtʃɛkɪŋ ðə ˈkæləndɚ oʊ hoʊld ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 稍等，我核對一下行事曆……噢，等一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did something just change on your end?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ˈsʌmθɪŋ dʒʌst tʃeɪndʒ ɑn jɔɹ ɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 你那邊剛剛發生什麼變動了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That slot moved to a dentist, my apologies.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt slɑt muːvd tə ə ˈdɛntɪst maɪ əˈpɑlədʒiz/
dialogue.zh: 真抱歉，那個時段牙醫先一步挪走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, these things happen. What else is open?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðiz θɪŋz ˈhæpən wət ɛls ɪz ˈopən/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，難免啦。還有哪些時段空著？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thursday the twenty-seventh, same time, still free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɝzˌdeɪ ðə ˈtwɛnti ˈsɛvənθ seɪm taɪm stɪl fri/
dialogue.zh: 二十七號星期四，同一時間，目前還空著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll take it before it disappears too, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl teɪk ɪt bɪˈfɔɹ ɪt ˌdɪsəˈpɪɹz tu hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 我趕緊訂下來，免得它也不見了，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Locked in. Anything else you'd like at the visit?
dialogue.phonetic: /lɑkt ɪn ˈɛniθɪŋ ɛls jʊd laɪk æt ðə ˈvɪzɪt/
dialogue.zh: 確定囉。就診時還想順便加點別的項目嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I add a flu shot while I'm there?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ ædə flu ʃɑt waɪl aɪm ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 我是不是可以順便打一劑流感疫苗？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, it's quick and covered by your plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪˈdiə ɪts kwɪk ænd ˈkʌvɚd baɪ jɔɹ plæn/
dialogue.zh: 好主意，一下就好，而且你的保險有給付。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then yes, please pencil that in too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn jɛs pliz ˈpɛnsəl ðæt ɪn tu/
dialogue.zh: 那就一併幫我登記進去吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done. Now, what's the best time to reach you?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn naʊ wɑts ðə bɛst taɪm tə ɹitʃ ju/
dialogue.zh: 搞定。聯繫你的話，什麼時候最合適？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Text me, calls scare me during lectures.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛkst mi kɔlz skɛɹ mi ˈdʊɹɪŋ ˈlɛktʃɚz/
dialogue.zh: 傳簡訊給我吧，上課時間的電話會嚇到我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, noted! I'll send a reminder the day before.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈnoʊɾɪd aɪl sɛnd ə ɹɪˈmaɪndɚ ðə deɪ bɪˈfɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，記下了！我會在前一天發提醒訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Is parking free at the clinic?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ɪz ˈpɑɾkɪŋ fri æt ðə ˈklɪnɪk/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。診所停車是免費的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First hour's free, bring the ticket to the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɝst ˈaʊɚz fri bɹɪŋ ðə ˈtɪkɪt tə ðə dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 第一小時免費，把停車票拿到櫃檯蓋章就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good to know. What should I bring that day?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tə noʊ wət ʃʊd aɪ bɹɪŋ ðæt deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。那麼就診當天我該帶些什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Insurance card, photo ID, and your list of questions.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪnˈʃʊɹəns kɑɹd foʊˌtaɪ aɪˈdi ænd jɔɹ lɪst əv ˈkwɛstʃənz/
dialogue.zh: 保險卡、附照片的身份證明，還有你的問題清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Questions, right, I'll write them down beforehand.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwɛstʃənz ɹaɪt aɪl ɹaɪt ðɛm daʊn bɪˈfɔɹˌhænd/
dialogue.zh: 問題清單，對，我會提前把它寫下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're all set, Daniel. Welcome to our clinic.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ɔl sɛt ˈdænjəl ˈwɛlkəm tə ɑʊɹ ˈklɪnɪk/
dialogue.zh: 全部搞定囉，Daniel。歡迎成為我們的病患。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you! Was calling on a Tuesday wise?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju wʌz ˈkɔlɪŋ ɑn ə ˈtuzˌdeɪ waɪz/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝！星期二打電話來算是聰明的選擇嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart move, mornings are phone chaos on Mondays.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt muv ˈmɔɹnɪŋz ɑɹ foʊn ˈkeɪˌɑs ɑn ˈmʌnˌdeɪz/
dialogue.zh: 很聰明，星期一上午的電話最為擁擠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good tip. Well, have a wonderful Thursday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tɪp wɛl hæv ə ˈwʌndɚfəl ˈθɝzˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 學到一招了。祝你有個愉快的星期四。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You too! Remember: water only, no coffee.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju tu ɹɪˈmɛmbɚ ˈwɔɾɚ ˈonli noʊ ˈkɑfi/
dialogue.zh: 你也是！記住：只能喝水，咖啡別碰。

script.youtube_title: 【第一次約美國健檢🩺】「空腹竟然不能喝咖啡？」打診所電話預約全過程📞💉⏰｜聽完就會自己約｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Booking a First Physical
script.youtube_title_en: "Fasting Means No Coffee?" — Booking My First Annual Physical by Phone
script.youtube_description:
「空腹連一點咖啡都不能喝嗎？」——剛搬來美國上學，身體一切都好，也該為自己約一次年度健檢。這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在一通打給家庭診所的預約電話裡。

你會聽到：開場說明來意與新病患登記；線上表格和保險卡的問答、會員編號怎麼口頭報出；健檢流程、膽固醇與血糖抽血，以及最關鍵的空腹規定；看好的時段讓牙醫先搶走時，怎麼有禮地再挑一個；流感疫苗、停車折讓、就診當日該帶清單的貼心提醒。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與十個詞以內的短句，反覆出現的是美國人講電話的真實語感：um、well、so、oh、right。聽完你就會用：I'm calling to book...、Do you have insurance?、What else is open?、I'll take that slot。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請訂閱並打開小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Wait, fasting means no coffee at all?" — you just moved to the US for school, you feel fine, and yet the clinic says a first annual physical is the smart thing to book. This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice built from one real phone call to a family clinic.

You will hear: explaining why you're calling and signing up as a new patient; online forms, insurance cards and reading out a member ID; what the checkup and blood work involve, including the eight-hour fasting rule; the polite redo when a slot gets taken by a dentist; plus flu shots, parking validation, and what to bring on visit day.

Everything stays at A2 level, ten words or fewer per line, with the fillers Americans use on real phone calls: um, well, so, oh, right. By the end you'll own lines like I'm calling to book a checkup, Do you have insurance? and I'll take that slot.

Chapter 4 is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.
